title: Bag and sleeve proofs on the bench
prompt: Overhead flat-lay photograph on a pale oak design-studio bench: two plain matte stand-up coffee bags with no printing, one warm cream and one muted eucalyptus green; a paper takeaway cup wearing a plain cream sleeve; a small heap of medium-roast coffee beans; a fan of plain painted paper colour chips in deep bark brown, cream, off-white, burnt orange and sage green; a sheet of tracing paper showing one continuous pencil line that traces a gentle hill ridge; a pencil and a scalpel. Soft north-facing daylight, gentle long shadows, calm editorial still life with natural paper and kraft textures.
promptSuffix: No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks. If people appear they are anonymous and not looking at the camera.
